name: Dark Winds
description: This psychological thriller follows two Navajo police officers, Leaphorn and Chee, in the 1970s Southwest as their search for clues in a grisly double murder case forces them to challenge their own spiritual beliefs and come to terms with the trauma of their pasts.

videos.title: Monster Slayer
videos.overview: Navajo Tribal Policeman Joe Leaphorn must solve a series of crimes. He partners with new deputy, Jim Chee, who is back on the reservation for the first time since he was a child. Together they face down evil forces both earthly and supernatural.

videos.title: The Male Rain Approaches
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Chee interview the surviving witness to the Big Rock Motel murders. Chee meets with the coroner-- the cause of death remains a mystery. Meanwhile, Sgt. Manuelito makes a chilling discovery of her own.

videos.title: K'e
videos.overview: Leaphorn's niece celebrates her Kinaaldá as Leaphorn retrieves the bodies of the murder victims. Meanwhile, Manuelito and Chee investigate the whereabouts of the missing Mormon family.

videos.title: Hooghandi
videos.overview: Leaphorn suspects all of the crimes on the reservation are related.There is a big break in the case. Leaphorn invites Chee over for dinner. Meanwhile, Manuelito makes a discovery of her own.

videos.title: Ha'i'i'nlni
videos.overview: With a major suspect in custody, Leaphorn discovers that there is more to this crime than he would have ever imagined. Manuelito faces her worst fears. Chee must make a choice between his career and his people.

videos.title: HózhóoNaasháa
videos.overview: Leaphorn, Chee, and Manuelito descend on the hiding place of the Buffalo Society, only to be confronted with hard decisions that could change the outcome of the rest of their lives.

videos.title: Na'niłkaadii
videos.overview: Navajo Tribal Policeman Joe Leaphorn investigates the death of a man involved in a mysterious cult. While Jim Chee, moonlighting as a PI, works a case of his own. When their investigations collide Leaphorn and Chee find themselves in grave danger.

videos.title: Wonders of the Unknown
videos.overview: Leaphorn explores personal ties to an increasingly mysterious case, while Chee is questioned by a reluctant Sgt. Manuelito. The discovery of a body sends Leaphorn and Manuelito in pursuit of a child in danger.

videos.title: Antigonish
videos.overview: After facing off with a dangerous man, Chee strikes out on his own. Meanwhile, Leaphorn and Manuelito partner with the sheriff's department, leading Leaphorn to identify a vital clue.

videos.title: The March
videos.overview: Leaphorn risks his life in pursuit of a suspect, while Manuelito stands up to the sheriff in a bid to rescue her boss. Seeking answers on a case, Chee considers a dangerous proposition.

videos.title: Black Hole Sun
videos.overview: With his suspect in custody, Leaphorn races against the clock to get a confession, while Chee goes under cover at the cult that ties their investigations together. Meanwhile, Manuelito counsels a teenager nervous about the draft.

videos.title: Hózhó náhásdlįį
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Chee discover evidence that connects their cases, only for Leaphorn to realize justice won't be easily served. Meanwhile, Manuelito prepares for a big life change.

videos.title: Ye'iitsoh (Big Monster)
videos.overview: Lt. Joe Leaphorn and Sgt. Jim Chee investigate the disappearance of a Navajo boy. Manuelito makes a sinister discovery while adjusting to life on the border patrol. An FBI agent comes to solve a case linked to Leaphorn's recent past.

videos.title: Náá'tsoh (Big Eyes)
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Chee find themselves on a manhunt after making a shocking discovery. Special Agent Washington questions Leaphorn about a person of interest. Manuelito puts her job on the line when she searches for answers at a local ranch.

videos.title: Ch'į́į́dii (Ghosts)
videos.overview: After a close call, Leaphorn and Chee follow the trail of a new suspect. The discovery of a body sends Special Agent Washington in a different direction. Manuelito puts a target on her back as she digs deeper into the mystery.

videos.title: Chahałheeł (Darkness Falls)
videos.overview: Chee pays Manuelito a visit after discovering a link between their cases. Leaphorn pursues a fugitive suspect. Special Agent Washington interviews an eyewitness to the crime she's investigating.

videos.title: Tsékǫ̨' Hasą́ní (Coal Mine Canyon)
videos.overview: Following a grisly murder, Leaphorn and Chee strike out on their own when the FBI take over their case. Special Agent Washington pays the Leaphorns an unexpected visit. Manuelito searches for evidence south of the border.

videos.title: Ábidoo'niidę́ę́ (What We Had Been Told)
videos.overview: Leaphorn is forced to confront his worst fears and darkest memories when he puts his life on the line to prevent another murder.

videos.title: T'áá Áłts'íísígo (Just a Small Piece)
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Chee retrace their steps after uncovering a vital clue; Special Agent Washington presses for more information; Manuelito moves quickly to execute a search warrant.

videos.title: Béésh Łį́į (Iron Horse)
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Chee call upon all their resources to solve the case and serve justice after learning the identity of the killer. Bernadette fights for her life after coming face-to-face with the truth.

videos.title: Kǫ' Tsiitáá Álnééh (Baptism by Fire)
videos.overview: Leaphorn, Chee and Bernadette search for a runaway girl.

videos.title: Bikéé' Doo Éédahoozįįdę́ę́góó (Toward Their Unknown Paths)
videos.overview: Leaphorn, Chee, and Manuelito uncover new clues to the missing girl's whereabouts in the wake of a deadly shooting.

videos.title: Ahááldláádígíí (That Which Has Been Torn Apart)
videos.overview: Leaphorn tracks the killer and discovers that he's the object of her dangerous obsession. Chee contemplates his future with Manuelito and the NTP while they investigate new leads. Billie faces an uncertain future.

videos.title: Ni' Ániidí (The New World)
videos.overview: Leaphorn, Chee and Manuelito search for Billie in Los Angeles. Chee is confronted by memories of his past while Leaphorn reconnects with Emma. Vaggan returns to the hunt when she learns that Billie is in town looking for her remaining family.

videos.title: Atída'ahiilyaágíí (Those Who Harmed One Another)
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Manuelito assist the FBI with an investigation in exchange for information on a new lead. Chee goes undercover to get intel on Billie's cousin. Billie makes a life-changing discovery.

videos.title: Shíká Nidanitáhą́ą́ (Those Who Were Searching for Me)
videos.overview: When Chee's new intel provides a clue to Vaggan's identity, Leaphorn enlists the FBI to help ambush the killer. Manuelito and Emma help Chee with his recovery from a close call while he is haunted by a specter from his past.

videos.title: Nániikai (We Came Back)
videos.overview: Leaphorn and Manuelito find themselves racing against the clock to save Billie from Vaggan. Chee recovers as he confronts the difficult truth about his past. Billie reconnects with a long-lost family member.

videos.title: Ni' Hodisxǫs (The Glittering World)
videos.overview: Leaphorn engages Vaggan in a battle of wills in order to and save himself and Billie from a grisly fate.

videos.title: Nina'aha'a'ha'a'gi (The Place to Which They Return)
To Nili Alts'aa Deezli (A River Splits in Two)
Yeego Aah Dasitih (He Holds on too Tight)
Eedeiilniihee Gi at eego (The Way We Remember)
Ch' eeh Adaho' dool' iid (The Attempts Were Futile)
T'aa Altso Ahalzhish (All Things Must Pass)
Nahast eidi Oolkil Gone (The Ninth Hour)
